model.per_side: each wire side is looked up separately; an isolated wire has 2 * ground(last row)
model.context: over = calibration metal index of the nearest conductor below (0 = substrate), under = nearest above
model.resistance: sheet_resistance * centerline_length / width; via = resistance_ohm_per_cut / cuts
model.overlap_area: metal of another layer that covers part of a wire face without forming a calibration plate couples over the covered width at overlap_area.pf_per_um2 (counted once, from the upper face), and the covered face loses area_cap_pf_per_um2 to the substrate; values are the Magic nominal defaultoverlap/defaultareacap times the calibration table's corner ratio (table_corner_ratio: plate excess of the same pair; substrate row for area_cap)

overlap_area.table_corner_ratio_source: substrate row (pair plate excess not positive)

diagnostics: calibration column 4 is not used; resistance is taken from the Magic extract section
DIAGUNDER (diagonal adjacent-layer) tables are not modeled
via cut and via landing-pad self capacitance are not modeled
